title: CI runs every check; a local gate runs what the diff can affect
context: The local final gate always ran the workflow-tool tests and a full Blueprint build, even for a change that could not affect them, yet never ran integration tests, while CI ran everything on every pull request.
decision: CI runs every check on every pull request and is the authority. pnpm verify runs format, lint, type checks, unit tests and check:workflow. pnpm verify:all also runs the app build, and adds only what the diff can affect: test:workflow for scripts/ or .github/, integration tests for backend src/ or test/integration/, Blueprint tests for blueprint/. No local gate builds the Blueprint site: CI and the branch-preview build do, and blueprint:gate reads the preview build's result once at G1 and G2 without polling. knip --production joins every gate once its findings are triaged.

alternatives.reason: Most of the time would go on checks the diff cannot affect.

alternatives.option: Build the Blueprint locally only when Features change
alternatives.reason: The branch-preview build already builds it on Linux for every push.

consequences: A Fix-path change has no gate, so an MDX error in a Feature page is caught by CI before merge.
